# Card W4s — one city's script (writer; parameter CITY)

Your spawn prompt gives `CITY=chicago`, `new-york` or `los-angeles`.

**Write one file:** `docs/story/<CITY>-SCRIPT.md`, in exactly the format of `docs/story/BOSTON-SCRIPT.md`, so the same transcription steps apply.

**Read:** `docs/story/CITIES-BIBLE.md`: the Summary, your city's section, and "Rules for the script writers" (not the other cities' sections); `docs/story/BOSTON-SCRIPT.md` for format and for two neighbourhoods' worth of pacing; the previous city's last scene, so your opening follows it.

## What to write
1. 24 main scenes: six neighbourhoods, four beats each, following the bible's arcs. Beat 3 is MegaSlice's move and the rival opening; beat 4 follows the player's won challenge.
2. 6–8 interludes carrying the bible's B-plot, each with an `after` delay suggestion and the main beat it holds back.
3. The returning characters' scenes the bible lists.
4. The opening scene (after the franchise moment) and the last panel. If `CITY=los-angeles`, also the showdown: one short scene before each of the five rounds, the ending scene and the last panel of the game.
5. Per neighbourhood: the perk name, four recipe cards (name and line), three head names with four barks each, and the layer copy for its layer kind (banner, chip, sheet title and body, one start line).

## Limits
Your brief's scene, panel and bubble limits. Keep the bible's names exactly. End every scene on a line that makes the next one wanted.

## Report
Standard writer report: scenes, interludes, longest line.
